title: The tangent space at a point with separable residue field extension as the dual of the cotangent space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a morphism of schemes f: X to S, a point x with s = f(x), and residue fields equal or related by a separable algebraic extension, the lemma identifies the fibre of the relative differentials with the cotangent space at x and consequently the tangent space with its dual (statement lines 3058-3077). The second identification is inherited from the previous duality lemma, so the content is the first: after reducing to the spectrum of the local ring of the fibre, the assertion becomes a purely algebraic statement about a local ring over a field k with separable algebraic residue field, where one must show that the canonical map from the cotangent space into the fibre of the module of differentials is an isomorphism (proof lines 3080-3093). The author rewrites the cotangent space as the first homology of the cotangent complex and reduces, by the transitivity exact sequence, to the vanishing of the differentials and of the first homology of the cotangent complex of the residue field over k; decomposing the separable algebraic extension as a filtered union of finite separable ones and using that a finite separable field extension is etale finishes the argument (proof lines 3094-3104). The claim is H2: three cited algebraic inputs with a clean transitivity reduction, but the passage through the cotangent complex is what makes the separability hypothesis do its work.
